description_en: Starts one or more simple application servers
description_zh: 启动一台或多台轻量应用服务器
name: StartInstances

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the simple application servers. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/189315.html to query the list of supported Alibaba Cloud regions
parameters.help_zh:
指定的轻量应用服务器实例所属的地域ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/189315.html查看支持的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. A client token is a unique string generated by your client. It can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多详情，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the simple application servers. The value can be a JSON array that consists of up to 100 instance IDs. Separate multiple instance IDs with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 轻量应用服务器的实例ID。取值可以由多个实例ID组成一个JSON数组，最多支持100个ID，ID之间用半角逗号（,）隔开
parameters.name: instance_ids
